name: Peer-to-peer rental index: datacenter PCIe L40S and RTX 6000 Ada (per-GPU-hour)
price_basis: USD per GPU-HOUR for the GPU component, verified peer-to-peer hosts, 1-GPU bundles, observed 2026-10-03. Asking rental rate, NOT a realised rental.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-vast-rental-api. TWO BANDS, both observed 2026-10-03, per-GPU-hour on verified hosts: L40S 1-GPU n=12, range $0.5348-$0.8161, median $0.7085; L40S 8-GPU n=6, median $0.8002, range $0.5336-$0.8149 - the per-card rate RISES with bundle size here, again SKU-specific. RTX 6000 Ada 1-GPU n=13, range $0.5345-$0.8022, median $0.6289; 4-GPU n=7, median $0.5606, range $0.4792-$0.6272. THE SEGMENT BOUNDARY: L40S (0.7085) and RTX 6000 Ada (0.6289) rent within ~13% of each other - both 48GB Ada-generation datacenter PCIe parts - while sitting ~6.5x below H100 SXM ($2.4704) and ~1.6x above RTX 4090 ($0.4289). Three clean rental tiers, and they line up with the purchase-market tiers in the sibling records.
